data.name: Virtual Driving School: Trucks
data.detailed_description:
Virtual Driving School: Trucks brings professional heavy vehicle training into a high-fidelity driving simulator designed for learning, not shortcuts.

Built on the proven Virtual Driving School platform, this edition focuses on HGV and bus driving, where mistakes are costly and awareness matters. Practice complex manoeuvres, understand your load and vehicle height, manage restricted spaces, and make safe decisions under pressure — all before you ever turn a real key.

From urban deliveries to industrial sites, rural routes to depots, VDS: Trucks lets you rehearse real-world scenarios repeatedly, safely, and at your own pace.

This is not arcade trucking. It’s skills-first, rules-first, and realism-first.

What You’ll Learn

Heavy Vehicle Fundamentals

• Wide turns, off-tracking, swing-out and tail swing
• Braking distances, weight transfer, and stopping performance
• Cab visibility, mirror use, blind spots, and vulnerable road users
• Urban, rural, and motorway HGV driving

Know Your Load

• Vehicle height awareness; rigid vs articulated vehicles
• Load changes and daily trailer variation
• Route planning with height, weight, and access restrictions
• Consequences of poor planning… without real-world damage

Bridge Strikes & Infrastructure Risk

• Approaching low bridges with realistic signage and distractions
• Decision-making under pressure
• GOAL (Get Out And Look) training
• What to do if a strike occurs — safely and correctly

Level Crossings & High-Risk Zones

• Rail level crossings with varied signalling and sightlines
• Industrial estates, yards, depots, and restricted manoeuvring zones
• Tight loading bays, awkward approaches, and poor visibility

Specialist Vehicle Operation

• Vehicle-mounted crane mode
• Pick-up, placement, and precision load handling
• Managing stability, space, and surroundings while operating equipment

Why You’ll Learn Faster (and Safer)

• Bite-size drills (1–5 mins): Reverse into bays, judge height, negotiate tight turns, crane placement, crossing checks.
• Scenario-based drives (20–40 mins): Realistic routes with layered hazards and scoring.
• Unlimited retries: Practice mistakes without cost, damage, or risk.
• Playback & feedback: Review decisions, hazards, and outcomes.

Real Rules, Real Roads

• UK-focused road rules, signage, and infrastructure
• Accurate bridges, crossings, depots, and industrial layouts
• Realistic AI traffic, pedestrians, cyclists, and site workers
• Temporary roadworks, diversions, and poor signage scenarios

Vehicles & Handling

• Rigid trucks, articulated HGVs, buses, and specialist vehicles
• Authentic weight, braking, and steering response
• Distinct cab layouts, mirrors, and sightlines
• Designed to teach anticipation, not reflex gaming

Game Modes

• Training Modules: Structured lessons focused on HGV-specific risks
• Scenario Drives: End-to-end routes with scoring and feedback
• Specialist Tasks: Crane operation, depot work, complex deliveries
• Free Drive: Explore environments and practice without pressure

Hardware & Control Support

• Steering wheels supported (Logitech, Fanatec, Moza, and more)
• Multi-monitor and VR-ready
• Keyboard, controller, and accessibility options supported

Built for Learning, Not Luck

Virtual Driving School: Trucks is used as the foundation for professional driver training and safety research. It’s designed to build judgement, awareness, and confidence: the things that prevent accidents before they happen.

Disclaimer:
Virtual Driving School: Trucks is a training-focused simulation and a supplement to real-world instruction. It does not replace certified professional driver training or licensing. Always follow local laws, regulations, and employer procedures.

data.short_description: Train like a professional HGV driver. Master trucks and buses, manage blind spots and long loads, avoid bridge strikes, navigate level crossings, and operate vehicle-mounted cranes. Real rules, real risks — zero real-world consequences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX960 / AMD R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX1060 / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 MB available space

  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
